csv_project_name: Single and Multi Family Energy Efficiency Programs
csv_scope_of_work: The Compact s Chief Procurement Officer hereby requests proposals from qualified professionals to provide energy related services Lead Vendor implementation and management services for the Cape Light Compact s single family (1-4 units) and multifamily residential (5+ units) turnkey services program (the Project ) The Program and its goals are delivered in alignment with the Compact s current Three-Year Energy Efficiency Plan. For more information on the single and multifamily residential turnkey services program(s), visit section 3.1.2. (Residential Turnkey Solutions) of The Massachusetts 2025-2027 Energy Efficiency and Decarbonization Plan. The RFP seeks a qualified Lead Vendor to manage and implement Cape Light Compact s residential turnkey services programs for single-family and multifamily customers, including program management, energy assessments, contractor oversight, energy efficiency and electrification services, heat pump and barrier mitigation projects, QA/QC, reporting, marketing, customer support, and incentive administration.
csv_comments: '- Contract Participation Goal: Prevailing Wage- Prevailing wage rates may apply.- Pre-Submittal Notes: Margaret Song via email at msong@capelightcompact.org no later than 12 p.m. EST on August 3, 2026.- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 08/05/2026 12:00 PM EDT- Pre-Submittal Location: Conference Call- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Recommended- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 08/05/2026 05:00 PM EDT Pre-Bid meeting August 5 at 12:00 PM EDT
title: Single and Multi Family Energy Efficiency Programs
short_description: Lead vendor sought for residential energy efficiency and electrification program management services.
project_scope: Implementation and management of residential energy efficiency programs for single-family homes (1-4 units) and multifamily buildings (5+ units) under the Cape Light Compact Three-Year Energy Efficiency Plan. Scope includes program management, energy assessments, contractor oversight, energy efficiency and electrification services, heat pump and barrier mitigation projects, QA/QC, reporting, marketing, customer support, and incentive administration.
services: Lead vendor implementation and management services; energy-related services; program management; energy assessments; contractor oversight; QA/QC; reporting; marketing; customer support; incentive administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an energy program management and implementation contract, not structural or bridge/building design.
- Requested disciplines are construction/project management and energy engineering.
- No indication of structural engineering, special structures, long spans, or architecturally demanding design work.
- Falls under services sbp generally does not prioritize, such as consulting/program management and energy services rather than structural planning.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost stated in the tender documents. The notice describes a multi-year program management and implementation contract for residential energy efficiency measures, but provides no budget, building quantities, or measure volumes from which a reliable construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information stated. As this is not a structural planning tender and no planning fee basis, budget, or construction cost is provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified professionals to provide energy-related lead vendor implementation and management services for residential turnkey programs; experience in program management, energy assessments, contractor oversight, electrification services, QA/QC, reporting, marketing, customer support, and incentive administration is implied.
contracting_authority: Cape Light Compact, South Yarmouth, MA, USA. Contact: Margaret Song. Phone: 508-375-6644. Email: msong@capelightcompact.org. Website: https://www.capelightcompact.org/news-and-resources/request-for-proposals-rfp/
notes: Contract duration/base period: 36 months; renewal option: 84 months. Pre-submittal meeting: 08/05/2026 12:00 PM EDT via conference call. Questions deadline: 08/05/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Renewable: Yes. Prevailing wage rates may apply. Although related to residential buildings, this is not a building design or structural engineering tender.
